newsitem.title: CHILE: Barrick Chile gold mine closed by snow.
newsitem.headline: Barrick Chile gold mine closed by snow.

text.p: Canadian mining company Barrick Gold's Tambo gold mine in Chile is closed because of heavy snow, while the nearby underground El Indio pit is working at a "minimum level," said a company spokesman.
Tambo, an open cast pit, was shut last week after blizzards dumped five meters of snow in the area, she said.
Communications to Tambo and El Indio, which lie three miles apart, have been cut by the bad weather, she said.
Miners are operating Tambo's mill using stockpiled mineral, while at El Indio a skeleton staff is carrying out maintenance in the pit and keeping the plant ticking over.
